title: S4-DRAW-12 — A normal is a surface, not paint.
goal: Normal Chisel refuses ordinary paint layers without adding history. On a surface layer, a stroke adds surface data that this view draws over the art; Undo removes it exactly and Redo restores it; hiding the surface layer shows Bun's original colors bit for bit, so the diffuse artwork itself never changed.
cliOnly: decoded normal-layer pixels before and after the stroke, from downloaded project backups

steps.why: The ordinary Base Layer refuses the chisel.
A surface layer is added without changing the visible colors.
The surface layer now holds data, drawn over the art in this view.
Undo removes the surface stroke exactly.
With the surface layer hidden, Bun's color artwork is exactly the original: the stroke was surface data, not paint.
